title: Duel Masters!
justification: Checked by episode title against TVDB series 325374 and TMDB show 46392. Its episodes are on TMDB show 46392. AniDB episode 1-51 ("ジョーのジョーカーズ, 自然文明に参ジョー" (Episode 1) to "虹色の願い! ももちゃんのニコニコ誕ジョー会!" (Episode 51)) are TMDB S14E1 "Episode 1" to TMDB S14E51 "Episode 51"; AniDB S1 "未来はジョージョー!? ジョーカーズVS自然文明VS闇文明スペシャル!" (Episode S1) has no TVDB episode (TVDB has no S0E1) and no TMDB episode (its default TMDB S0E1 is "Looking Back Special! Joe VS Deckie, a Serious Duema!!", another item). TMDB 46392 season 14 is named Duel Masters!, the node's title, with 51 episodes from 2018-04-01 to 2019-03-31 like AniDB's.
